collection.title: Proton Satria 2007 to 2015 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Proton Satria 2007 to 2015 will fit, this model requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm, there is also the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Satria which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
